issues.detail: Natural violaceoid E is revised to (4R,5R)-1; (4R,5S)-1 is the synthesized proposed structure and not the natural-product assignment.
issues.subject: 1-RR / 1-RS

issues.detail: Source HRMS formula prints C26H40NaO3SeSi+; drawing/name and reported calculated 547.1753 require O4. Canonical graph uses O4, while the original printed formula is preserved in the HRMS observation.

Several mass/mmol pairs do not agree with the assigned formulas (e.g. 15, 17, final 1-RS); final MBH formaldehyde amount also differs from concentration/volume. Reported yields are retained, quantities are not silently repaired.
issues.subject: 15/17/1-RS and formaldehyde

issues.detail: Scheme 3 lists pyridine; experimental procedure for 20 does not. Procedure agents are retained and this difference remains explicit.
issues.subject: V15

issues.detail: Enone 4 is cited to earlier literature. No commercial-start completeness is claimed.

3 is a 3:1 mixture with 68% combined yield, not 68% for each stereoisomer. Epoxidation products 11/12 use their individually reported isolated yields. Dot-separated reaction endpoints do not imply stoichiometric atom balance.
issues.subject: 3alpha/3beta and 11/12

issues.detail: Scheme-only side products have no reported isolated yields; Se-bearing center of 7 is unspecified. No arbitrary yield, reagent identity or stereochemistry is filled in.
Local OPSIN resolves source systematic names; source drawings and formula checks were compared. Independent chemist review remains pending.
